title: Contraception (Birth Control)
summary: Contraception means methods that prevent pregnancy: barrier methods (condoms), hormonal methods (pill, injection, implant, patch, ring), IUDs, sterilisation and fertility-awareness methods.
key_points: Implants and IUDs are over 99% effective in typical use; the pill is around 91–93%; condoms about 85%.
Only condoms (external/internal) also protect against most STIs.
Combining a condom with another method gives strong protection.
answer_guidance: Give an overview first; for choosing a method or side effects, suggest a doctor or clinic.
